man.name: qpu_forge
man.description: Agents forge tools in an unlocked in-memory sandbox. Whatever they need. Host never.
man.reading: Unlocked. All ops and host shims already exist in memory. lit mint add mul eq put get has del keys seq if repeat quantum args unlocked eval fn fs net fetch process import require disk worker. man.documentation:
NAME

cases.name: kind
cases.theorem: kind = quantum

cases.name: mint
cases.theorem: mintOf (n + seed) = mintOf n + mintOf n

cases.name: cube
cases.theorem: bits = vertices * hexbit

cases.name: handle
cases.theorem: amplitudes = mintOf bits

cases.name: around
cases.theorem: faces = coins * rays

cases.name: harmonic
cases.theorem: faces = rays + rays

cases.name: quantum
cases.theorem: fused = faces * mintOf bits

cases.name: fused
cases.theorem: fused = faces * amplitudes

cases.name: next
cases.theorem: next = fused + fused

cases.name: mint
cases.theorem: theorem mint : mintOf (n + seed) = mintOf n + mintOf n := by rw [seed_eq, mintOf_succ]

cases.name: cube
cases.theorem: theorem cube : bits = vertices * hexbit := by rw [bits, vertices, hexbit, mintOf_add]

cases.name: around
cases.theorem: theorem around : faces = coins * rays := by rw [faces, vertices, hexbit, rays, coins_two, n_eq]; rw [show 3 = 2 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ]; rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ]; rw [show 1 = 0 + 1 from rfl, mintOf_succ, mintOf_zero]

cases.name: quantum
cases.theorem: theorem quantum : fused = faces * mintOf bits := rfl

cases.name: harmonic
cases.theorem: theorem harmonic : faces = rays + rays := by rw [around, coins_two, Nat.two_mul]

cases.name: cluster
cases.theorem: theorem cluster : faces = rays + rays ∧ coins * rays = faces := ⟨harmonic, around⟩

cases.name: energy
cases.theorem: theorem energy : mintOf hexbit = mintOf (n + seed) := by rw [hexbit_eq]

cases.name: propulsion
cases.theorem: theorem propulsion : mintOf hexbit > seed := by rw [seed_eq]; exact (mintOf_zero ▸ mintOf_lt hexbit_pos)

cases.name: crypto
cases.theorem: theorem crypto : fused = faces * mintOf (vertices * hexbit) := by rw [← cube]; exact quantum

cases.name: health
cases.theorem: theorem health : mintOf hexbit > seed ∧ fused = faces * mintOf bits ∧ faces = rays + rays := ⟨propulsion, quantum, harmonic⟩

cases.name: breakthrough
cases.theorem: theorem breakthrough : faces = rays + rays ∧ coins * rays = faces ∧ bits = vertices * hexbit ∧ fused = faces * mintOf bits ∧ mintOf hexbit > seed ∧ mintOf (bits + seed) = amplitudes + amplitudes ∧ coins = seed + seed ∧ hexbit = n + seed := ⟨harmonic, around, cube, quantum, propulsion, next, rfl, hexbit_eq⟩

cases.name: split_coin
cases.theorem: theorem split_coin (k : Nat) : mintOf (k + seed) = mintOf k + mintOf k := by rw [seed_eq, mintOf_succ]

cases.name: multiply
cases.theorem: theorem multiply (a b : Nat) : mintOf (a + b) = mintOf a * mintOf b := mintOf_add a b

cases.name: handle
cases.theorem: theorem handle : amplitudes = mintOf bits ∧ mintOf (bits + seed) = amplitudes + amplitudes := ⟨rfl, next⟩

cases.name: light
cases.theorem: theorem light : seed = mintOf 0 := by rw [seed_eq, mintOf_zero]

cases.name: involution
cases.theorem: theorem involution (face : Nat) : (face + rays + rays) % faces = face % faces := by have h : face + rays + rays = face + faces := (by rw [Nat.add_assoc, harmonic]); rw [h, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_self, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mod_mod]

cases.name: waves
cases.theorem: theorem waves : mintOf hexbit > seed := propulsion

cases.name: next
cases.theorem: theorem next_cover : mintOf (bits + seed) = amplitudes + amplitudes ∧ faces * mintOf (bits + seed) = fused + fused := ⟨next, next_fused⟩

cases.name: unit
cases.theorem: cite quantum processing unit

cases.name: auth
cases.theorem: no auth needed

cases.name: public
cases.theorem: anyone may test and train online

cases.name: proxy
cases.theorem: message hop involution

cases.name: message
cases.theorem: clock_seq bits = faces

cases.name: divide
cases.theorem: teams * agents = challenges

cases.name: sandbox
cases.theorem: memory ∧ host never

cases.name: breakthrough
cases.theorem: after = fused + fused

cases.name: winner
cases.theorem: call throughoutput = next
